summary: Vetmanager created the export build, but the current credentials are not authorized to download its file.
steps: Tell the user that report creation succeeded but file download authorization failed.
Ask an administrator to restore or re-authorize the Vetmanager integration.
After authorization is corrected, retry get_report_export_download with the same report_file_id.
do_not_do: Do not call start_report_export again: creating another file does not repair download authorization.
Do not retry the unauthorized download in a loop.
user_message_template: Файл отчёта создан, но Vetmanager не разрешил скачать его с текущей авторизацией. Нужна повторная авторизация интеграции; новый запуск экспорта проблему не исправит.
